WORK EXPERIENCE
Maverics Systems Ltd Lead Data Scientist May 2025–Present | Gurgaon
Designed and deployed machine learning models for large-scale data analysis and insights generation. Wroked on a Rag and Langchain based Gen AI project. Built automated ETL pipelines for data preprocessing and feature engineering using Python. Optimized SQL queries for efficient database performance in predictive modeling. Managed a team of developers. Implemented MLOps best practices, including CI/CD pipelines for machine learning model deployment. Gathered BRD working across teams. Been part of Excess Management program and workrd on Java along with Python.
TechnoSapphire Research Data Scientist Feb 2024–MAY 25 | Noida
Designed and deployed machine learning models for large-scale data analysis and insights generation. Developed deep learning architectures (CNNs, RNNs) for NLP and computer vision applications. Built automated ETL pipelines for data preprocessing and feature engineering using Python. Created interactive dashboards to visualize model performance and business insights. Worked with cloud-based data lakes and warehouses (AWS, Azure) to manage large-scale datasets. Been part of several Gen AI and Agentic AI projects to enhance skills in the field of developing Gen AI field.
